system.description:
Once per round, in place of one ranged attack, choose a creature you can see within your weapon's range. The next attack it makes before the start of your next turn has Disadvantage, unless it attacks you.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.name: Covering Fire
activities.text: In place of one ranged attack: the next attack the target makes before the start of your next turn has Disadvantage, unless it attacks you.
